text: dsh-task-notify 是一款面向 DSH 的跨平台任务完成通知插件，通过监听目标状态变化和会话回合结束事件，在 Windows、macOS 或 Linux 桌面显示原生系统通知。用户可以分别启用目标完成和 Agent 正常结束一轮两种提醒，设置通知标题，并调整通知之间的最小间隔以减少连续提示。Windows 使用系统 toast，macOS 使用通知中心，Linux 依次尝试 notify-send、zenity 和 kdialog。适合希望离开终端或切换窗口时仍能及时知道 DSH 工作已完成的用户。配置项均有默认值，不需要 API 密钥或外部账号。

dsh-task-notify sends native desktop notifications when a DSH goal completes or an agent turn ends normally. It supports Windows toast, macOS Notification Center, and Linux notification tools, with configurable triggers, title, and minimum interval. No API key or external account is required.
任务跑完后能不能在桌面弹个系统通知？
我想在目标完成或 Agent 回复结束时收到提醒。
How can I get a native desktop alert when a DSH task finishes?
dsh-task-notify 的功能「完成事件提醒」：目标进入 complete 状态或 Agent 正常结束一轮时发送桌面通知。通过两个独立配置项控制是否启用这两类提醒。
dsh-task-notify 的功能「原生跨平台通知」：在 Windows、macOS 或 Linux 显示系统通知；Linux 依次尝试 notify-send、zenity 和 kdialog，并允许设置标题与最小间隔。

dsh-task-notify README · dsh-task-notify：[English](README.md) | [中文](README.zh.md)

> A [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that shows a **native OS system notification** whenever a task completes — goal completion or agent turn end. **Windows / macOS / Linux**.

dsh-task-notify README · Features：- **Native OS notifications** on every platform: Windows toast, macOS Notification Center, Linux libnotify — real system banners, not blocking dialogs.
- **Two "task done" triggers** (configurable):
  - goal completes (`phase = complete`)
  - an agent turn ends normally
- **Zero runtime dependencies** — Node built-ins + OS-native commands (PowerShell, osascript, notify-send).
- **CJK-safe** — Windows text travels via UTF-8 temp files so Chinese/Japanese/Korean content is never corrupted.
- **Anti-spam** rate-limit between notifications.

dsh-task-notify README · Platform support：| OS      | Mechanism                          | Requires                        |
|---------|------------------------------------|----------------------------------|
| Windows | WinRT toast (Notification Center)  | nothing (AUMID registered at runtime) |
| macOS   | `osascript` `display notification` | macOS 10.8+                     |
| Linux   | `notify-send` (libnotify)         | libnotify (`notify-send`); falls back to zenity, then kdialog |

dsh-task-notify README · How it works (Windows)：1. On first notify, the plugin registers an **AppUserModelID** (`dsh.tasknotify`) under `HKCU\Software\Classes\AppUserModelId` so `CreateToastNotifier` can deliver to the interactive desktop.
2. When a task completes, it writes the title/body to UTF-8 temp files and runs a small PowerShell script that shows a WinRT `ToastText02` notification via `ToastNotificationManager`.
3. Temp files are removed afterwards. Failures are logged (never thrown) so they never break an agent turn.
dsh-task-notify README · How it works (Windows)：Each notification (and any failure) is recorded in an audit log at `<home>/task-notify.log`.

dsh-task-notify README · Install：As a dsh bundle, installable via the profile plugin manager:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-task-notify
```

Or install the repo directly (npm alias spec):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:YuMo226/dsh-task-notify
```

dsh-task-notify README · Manual install (no pnpm)：Copy this package into the profile's hoisted `node_modules` and add a loader entry:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: notify
      name: dsh-task-notify
      config:

> Restart `dsh web` after installing for the plugin to mount.

dsh-task-notify README · Configuration：| Key            | Type      | Default             | Description                                        |
|----------------|-----------|---------------------|----------------------------------------------------|
| `onGoalComplete` | boolean | `true`             | Notify when a goal completes.                      |
| `onTurnEnd`      | boolean | `true`             | Notify when an agent turn ends normally.           |
| `title`          | string  | `DeepSeek Harness` | Leading line of the notification.                  |
| `minIntervalMs`  | number  | `4000`             | Minimum ms between two notifications (anti-spam).  |

dsh-task-notify README · Troubleshooting：- **Windows**: make sure the notification center is on and Focus Assist is not set to "Alarms only" / "Priority only".
- **Linux**: install libnotify (provides `notify-send`); if missing, the plugin falls back to zenity, then kdialog.
- If no notification appears, check `<home>/task-notify.log` for an error line and [open an issue](https://github.com/YuMo226/dsh-task-notify/issues).
